tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kye rdo rje la bstod pa sh+lau ka gnyis pa bzhugs pa'o// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dpal kyai rdo rje la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin nam mkha'i khams ltar gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dri bsal zhing / /mkhyen pa'i ye shes shel la tshon bzhin shes bya kun la khyab par 'jug /brtse ba'i thugs rje yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro la 'dod dgu'i dpal stsol ba/ /bla ma mchog nyid spyi bos thod bzhin dus gsum kun tu bkur bar bgyi/ /gang gi rang bzhin bde stong dbyer med 'dod pa'i 'gro ba rjes gzung phyir/ /sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs sprul pa du ma dpag yas kyis/ /'gro ba kun la mig 'phrul mkhan bzhin sna tshogs gar gyis lam ston pa/ /kye yi rdo rje dpal mgon mchog la rab tu dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /༄༅/ /mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho la bstod pa/ swasti pra dzā bh+yaḥ gsung gi mnga' bdag 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal srid bzhi mdo'i rtswa ltar rab spangs shing / /kha ba can du bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /sdom brtson rkang gnyis smra ba rnams kyi rje/ /mkhan po mkhas mchog zhi ba 'tsho la 'dud/ /gang gis sngon tshe snyigs dus 'dzam bu'i gling / /gang na thub pa'i bstan pa mi gsal ba/ /der ni rgyal ba'i phrin las rdzogs mdzad par/ /smon pa'i dbang las bod khams mgon gyur cing / /bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /phyogs dang phyogs kyi tha grur rgyas mdzad de/ /bstan las ring song ma lus skye bo'i tshogs/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i phyag gis legs drangs nas/ /yang dag thar pa'i lam la rab bkod de/ /kun la phan bde'i dga' ston bskrun mdzad pa'i/ /mkhan po khyed nyid dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa ma lags sam/ /de slad thub pa'i bstan la'ang bstan pa yi/ /khur chen khyer ba khyed dang mtshungs med na/ /khyed las lhag par gyur pa ma mchis zhes/

/blo dman bdag gis da gdod khums par 'tshal/ /gzhan yang khyed kyi sku gdung bzhag pas kyang / /bstan pa skyong dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad na/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis thar 'dod skye bo'i tshogs/ /ngoms par mdzad la ya mtshan ci zhig mchi/ /de phyir gdul dka' 'dul ba dang / /rab rib mtha' dag drungs 'byin phyir/ /shākya'i dbang po'i bstan 'di yang / /bstan pa gzhan las lhag par 'tshal/ /mkhan po nyid kyi phrin las las/ /mi rje khri srong btsan po'i ring / /thos bsam dri med bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /sngon med bskrun par mdzad de'ang rmad/ /de slad mkhas grub chu skyes tshal/ /blo gsal bung ba'i dga' ston slad/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rkang 'thung la/ /lhan cig 'gran par 'dus pa la/ /lta ngan rgyu skar bye ba'i tshogs/ /khyod kyi dge legs snang byed kyi/ /dpal la 'gran par ma bzod de/ /mtha' yi phyogs su bros pa bzhin/ /dad ldan kun da'i tshogs rnams la/ /khyod kyi phrin las bsil ba'i zer/ /gangs ri'i phyogs su lhung ba yis/ /ya mtshan gyur te bsnyegs pa bzhin/ /de phyir bdag blo'i dpag bsam shing / /thos bsam ting 'dzin yal 'dab can/ /bslab gsum dag pa'i 'bras ldan pa/ /dang ba'i rlung shugs kyis bskyod de/ /khyod kyi sku gdung ring bsrel la/ /bsod nams spel slad mchod pa'i phyir/ /dad ldan gzhan dang lhan cig tu/ /lus ngag bcas te 'dud par bgyid/ /skye bo ya mtshan 'gyur ba'i slad/ /spos mchog yid 'phrog drir ldan pa'i/ /sna tshogs byug pa gser sogs kyis/ /sku gdung mchog la mchod bgyi zhing / /sna tshogs gos kyis bres pa yi/ /na bza' dam pa 'di nyid dang / /dngos dang yid sprul sgrub pa yi/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /bgyid du stsal dang / bgyis la yi rang gang bgyis pa'i/ /sdig pa'i tshogs rnams bshag bgyi zhing / /slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid/ /byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa yi/

/dus gsum dge la yi rang zhing / /'gro ba ma rig mun 'thoms la/ /chos kyi sgron ma'i 'od 'byung gsol/ /nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs shing / /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro ba byang chub chen por smon/ /slar yang bde gshegs sras dang bcas/ /sgrib med thugs rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ /yud tsam bdag gi don slad du/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni lhag pa'i bsam ldan pas/ /thub pa'i bka' dang mi 'gal bar/ /srog gi phyir yang dam pa'i chos/ /nam yang gtong bar mi bgyid la/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag can chos/ /g.yel ba med par sgrub 'dod kyang / /sngon gyi las 'phro mi bzang bas/ /snyigs ma lnga yi dbang song zhing / /rnam dpyod blo mig dang bral la/ /lta ngan tsher mas rab dkrugs pa'i/ /'khyog po'i yid can skye dgu yi/ /tshogs su nye bar 'khor gyur te/ /bdag gzhan gnod pa du ma yi/ /longs spyod sgrub pas dbyen spyod pa/ /'di 'dra khyed kyi thugs rje yis/ /myur ba nyid du bzlog tu gsol/ /gti mug shas che'i ngan 'gro yang / /bskul na gzhan gyi don bgyid na/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i spyan mnga' ba/ /khyed la gsol ba ji ltar dgongs/ /mdor na khyed kyi mthu stobs kyis/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gyi/ /mi bde thams cad phyir bsal te/ /'di dang gzhan du bde ba stsol/ /yang yang bdag gis gsol ba la/ /btang snyoms nyid du mi mdzad par/ /che cher dgongs te bdag gzhan don/ /lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar gsol la nongs pa'i tshogs/ /tshogs mchog rgyal ba tshogs bcas la/ /bzod par gsol zhing sku gsum tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis 'bras bu mthar phyin shog /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /chos kyi dbang phyug chos rje'i rjes 'brangs te/ /lung rigs smra ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes byas gus pa'i yid kyis sbyar/

/zhes pa 'di thub pa'i dbang po dang gnyis su med pa mkhan po mkhas grub zhi ba 'tsho'i dbu thod la mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar zhing / bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel nye bar bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ gung thang gi gtsug lag khang chen por dpa' bo'i lo dbo can gyi zla ba'i nyer brgyad kyi nyin par myur ba nyid du bsdebs pa dge legs su gyur cig/ ༄/ /lo tsā ba blo brtan la mdzad pa// phun tshogs mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / /tshad med thugs rje'i dba' rlabs phreng ba can/ /dpag yas phrin las nor bu'i gter gyur pa/ /sngon med chu bdag zas gtsang sras la 'dud/ /don bzang ge sar kun nas rab rgyas tshig 'bru bzang po'i 'dab stong can/ /tshangs spyod bzhi yi sbrang rtsis legs gtams nyes pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos shing / /dpal stug nyin byed zer gyis rab phye mkhas pa'i bung bas legs bsten pa'i/ /dus gsum dge ba'i dam chos ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan gang de'ang spyi bor bkur/ /blo gros rkang 'thung rtsa ba rab brtan lung dang rtogs pa'i yal 'dab can/ /bslab gsum dag pa'i me tog gis brgyan rnam grol yangs pa'i 'bras bus spud/ /phan bde'i dri bsung phyogs kun ldang bas 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i/ /bsod nams zhing mchog dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshogs la'ang gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros 'od ldan cha yi cha tsam shes bya'i mkha' la shar bas kyang / /mkhas la rgyu skar bye ba'i tshogs kyi blo la gzi 'od nyams byed cing / /phas rgol grub mtha'i pha rol son par mngon rlom mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /gnyis skyes blo mig rnam par ldong byed brtan mtshan spel 'grig na'ang sa mgo dgos/ pa nyin mor byed pa'i dpal/ /gang gi yon tan cha shas tsam yang mkhas pa'i mkhas pas nyin bzhin du/ /bskal pa'am bskal pas lhag par brjod kyang mtha' yi tshad yod ma mchis pas/ /thub pa'i bstan la thub dbang gnyis bzhin grags pas phyogs kun lham me ba/

/blo gros brtan pa lung rigs dga' ston spel slad yun ring rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig rgyal ba'i gsung rab ri ngogs su/ /sgra dang tshad ma'i 'dab gshog yongs rdzogs shing / /rig pa'i gnas lnga'i mkha' la legs rgyu pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin mkha' lding dbang po'i zhabs drung du/ /legs bshad stobs kyis blo yi lus rdzogs shing / /thos dang brtson pa'i 'dab gnyis legs rgyas pas/ /lung rigs mkha' la 'jigs med spobs pa can/ /mkha' lding dbang po'i rjes 'jug 'di skad gsol/ /gang gi sku la bsnyun med bde gyur cig /chos kyi gtam gyis dub par ma gyur tam/ /gang gi mkhyen pa'i ri bong 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /mkhas pa ku mud tshal du snang gyur tam/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin mche ba rab dkar ba'i/ /rtsod pa'i seng ges phyi rgol glang po'i tshogs/ /rigs pa'i sder mos log par lta ba yi/ /srog dang phral te pham par byas gyur tam/ /gang gi grags pa'i dri bzang phyogs kun tu/ /rnam par rgyug pa'i spos ngad ldan pa yis/ /bdag yid sna yi dbang po kun khyab pas/ /zag med bde bas yid kun khyab pa snyam/ /bdag kyang rmongs pa'i rab rib kun bral ba'/ི /blo mig dag pas sna tshogs mdo rgyud don/ /dbyibs legs ches cher bkra ba du ma zhig /yang yang blta bas ngoms pa med par mchis/ /skabs kyi don snyan du gsol ba ni/ rgyal ba lta bur khyod kyi phrin las kyang / /gdul bya kun la mnyam du 'jog mod kyi/ /gang zhig legs par bshad pa'i snod gyur ba'i/ /blo mig rnam dag sbyangs pa mi dman zhing / /gzur gnas chos don gnyer ba'i skye bo yang / /nyin mo'i skar ma lta bur ches nyung zhing / /brtson pas ring du sbyangs kyang shes bya yi/ /phyogs re tsam la'ang blo gros ma byang ba'i/ /skye bo rnams la nyin bzhin legs bshad kyi/ /sbyin pa'i tsha zer yang yang spros gyur kyang / /mig med rnams la sna tshogs gzugs ston zhing /

/khyed kyis mkhyen te mkhas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /chos kyi dga' ston dus la bstod pa rnams/ /legs bshad nor gyis dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rab tu brtson pa yi/ /rta bdun gyis drangs myur bar bskyod pa'i rigs/ /zhes pa'i zhu yig spyan lam du 'bul ba'i rten tsam du/ dar gyi srin bu'i kha chu las grub pa'i ngur mig gi gos cig 'bul/ rab myos kyi lo/ dka' thub can gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bco lnga la/ mkhas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi bsti gnas mchog tu gyur pa dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas rigs pa dang grol bar smra ba'i spobs pa can/ mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ phrin yig tu gsol ba'i yi ge/ slad nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'jig rten mig /lta spyod ngan pa'i tsher mas ma dkrugs shing / /de 'dzin khyed kyang sku tshe brtan pa yis/ /'gro la phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog/ ༈ lo tsā ba chen po blo gros brtan pa la mdzad pa/ ༄༅/ /'di'ang lo tsā ba la mdzad pa/ gang gi mkhyen pa'i yon tan dpag yas pa/ /dzam+bus mtshan pa'i gling du khyab gyur pas/ /dog par gyur pa nam mkha' skabs phye bzhin/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i blo gros rab brtan rgyal/ /de yi phun tshogs cha yi cha tsam yang / /tshu rol mthong bas dpag par mi bzod kyang / /rmig rjes chu yis rgya mtsho mtshon pa ltar/ /cha shas tsam zhig gus pa'i blo yis brjod/ /bskal mang du mar dge tshogs dpag med pas/ /thugs kyi bang mdzod gtams las gzhon nu'i dus/ /u rgyan grub pa'i skyes bus byin brlabs te/ /bshes gnyen chen po+or lung bstan brnyes la 'dud/ /gang gis lo grangs lnga par gyur pa na/ /dge bsnyen nod tshe rin chen byang gling pas/ /nyid kyi gdan bzhag bshes gnyen lung bstan pa/ /blo gros brtan par mtshan gsol la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas lo bdun bzhes tshe 'dul 'dzin mchog

/gser khang men ston gnyis la rab byung nas/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i pha rol legs son te/ /btsun pa zla bral tshul khrims rab brtan 'dud/ /lo bcu la babs chu bo chen po la/ /grogs kyis khur tshe rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i khur/ /ma lus khur phyir stobs la 'gran zla bral/ /zhes gsungs kun gyis bstod par gyur la 'dud/ /bcu gsum 'dul ba gsungs tshe kun gyis bstod/ /de rjes sa skyar byon tshe stag bde ba'i/ /snyan pa gsan te tsha snar de nyid las/ /chos mngon mthar phyin bcu drug par gsungs 'dud/ /de rjes phar phyin rnam par nges pa yi/ /gzhung lugs legs sbyangs bco brgyad pa la gsungs/ /sems bskyed ma nor mdo sde dbu ma sogs/ /dus kyi 'khor lo mthar son bsnyengs bral 'dud/ /zab yangs mdo rgyud phyi nang bstan bcos kun/ /lo drug bar ma chad du bsten pa las/ /mkhas mchog bla ma'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /gsal bar mngon du gyur la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rigs pa'i seng ge bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /de yi bka' drin chen pos rjes bzung bas/ /bcu dgu bzhes tshe bla ma dbyings su bzhud/ /rtag par rgya che'i mchod pas mchod la 'dud/ /ma 'gar khra tshang mchog ldan bla ma'i drung / /sgra dang snyan ngag zab rgyas chos mang gsan/ /dgun tshe sa skyar bla ma 'jam nyid la/ /rgyud dang rigs chos dpag med mthar phyin 'dud/ /dpyid dus mkhan chen gser khang pa yi drung / /bsnyen par rab rdzogs sems bskyed bslab btus sogs/ /chos mngon nod tshe 'jig rten kun gyi mig /lo tsā chen por lung bstan mdzad la 'dud/ /slob dpon me nu 'dul ba 'dzin pa las/ /dge tshul dge slong sdom pa legs nod cing / /so thar skyes rabs la sogs chos mang gsan/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol son la 'dud/ /slob dpon byang chub stobs las gsang ston zhus/ /sa skyar byon tshe sgra yi bstan bcos sogs/ /nyid kyis legs bris 'phral skad sna tshogs sbyangs/

/'du 'dzi spangs te legs sbyar don gnyer 'dud/ /'gro ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po dang / /paṇ+ḍi ta yi skad kyi srad sbyar bar/ /lo tsā'i mtshan gsol snyan ngag bstan bcos mdzad/ /smra rig yo byad chos bzang gis sbyar 'dud/ /bal por ra mā ma da ā tsār+yar/ /nyer gcig pa la tsan+d+ra sogs gsan nas/ /sa skyar byon nas ka lā pa bsgyur te/ /gangs can legs sbyar dga' ston bkyes la 'dud/ /bshes gnyen dam pa dog shing zhes grags pas/ /gus pas yo byad rnam mang rab sbyar te/ /slar yang bal por byon nas bstan bcos dang / /rgyud ris sku gzugs rnam mang bzhengs la 'dud/ /nyid kyi bzhed pa'i don kun mthar phyin nas/ /slar yang sa skyar byon tshe kun gyis bkur/ /mig ser bsnyun gyis btab par gyur na yang / /snyan ngag phreng bas bsnyun bral mdzad la 'dud/ /snga dang phyi mar lan grangs bdun gyi mthar/ /bal por 'bad pa chen po legs byon nas/ /sgra dang gso ba gtan tshigs nang rig pa/ /bsgyur cing zhus te de don gsal mdzad 'dud/ /gang gi mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /rgya bal gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan gyur/ /so gnyis dus na phar tshad mngon gsum dang / /rigs gter dus 'khor dga' ston 'gyed la 'dud/ /slar yang nyid thugs thos pas mi ngoms phyir/ /so gnyis nas bzung lo grangs nyer lnga'i bar/ /mchog ldan dge 'dun brtan pa'i zhal snga nas/ /chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' dag brnyes la 'dud/ /gzhan yang zab yangs rgyud sde kun gyi don/ /sbyor drug dbu chen gcod skor ma lus pa/ /zab khrid mtha' dag ri 'dabs pa zhes pa'i/ /bla ma mchog las thugs chud phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa'i grogs po'i g.yo ba ring du spangs/ /bdud kyi zhags pa'i 'ching ba che las grol/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston bcud kyis tshim/ /don dam spros pa kun bral thugs chud 'dud/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen sgron ma'i gling /

/dbus gtsang mkhas pa'i grwa pa phal mo che/ /kun gyis spyan drangs thod bzhin spyi bos bkur/ /legs bshad char gyis 'gro kun tshim mdzad 'dud/ /thub pa'i bstan pa phyogs kun rgyas pa dang / /blo gsal blo yi bang mdzod rgyas bya zhing / /mkhas mang dga' bskyed gzhan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /rig pa'i gnas rnams gsal bar mdzad la 'dud/ /de slad rgyud dang rgyud 'grel yan lag bcas/ /mdo dang bstan bcos de 'grel yan lag rnams/ /bsgyur cing zhu chen 'grel pas gsal mdzad de/ /legs bshad gter gyis 'gro kun tshim mdzad 'dud/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bzlas dang sgom pa dang / /gtor ma zhal ton rtsom bsgyur 'chad pa yi/ /dus las mi yol bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs phyir/ /longs spyod rtag tu don yod mdzad la 'dud/ /thog mar dgung lo bdun pa nas bzung ste/ /drug cu bdun par bstan pa gsal mdzad pas/ /nyid thugs rangs te nag zla'i bcu gsum la/ /dge bcas bde ba can du gshegs la 'dud/ /bla ma'i yon tan rgya chen 'dzin ma'i khyon/ /thub bstan lhun po'i dbang po rab 'dzin ltar/ /bstod pa 'di yang bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /mkha' ltar yangs pa rtag tu 'dzin gyur cig /de skad smra ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes byas bla ma'i drin thob las/ /go ba sla phyir snyan ngag rab spangs nas/ /don la gnas pa'i tshul 'di legs par bkod/ /lhag dman mi gsal ma tshang 'gal ba sogs/ /yongs 'dzin mchog la nongs gang bzod par gsol/ /'di yi dge ba ston tshe'i nam mkha'i ngogs/ /nya ba'i zla ltar kun tu rgyas par shog /bkra shis par gyur cig /mkhan chen byang rtse bas bskul nas mdzad pa yin gsungs/ ༄༅/ /bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa/ na mo rat+na gu ru we/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i gter/ /phyogs rnams kun tu snyan pa'i dris khyab pa/

/srid dang zhi ba'i dpal kun 'byung ba yi/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la gus btud nas/ /don bzang 'dab rgyas snyan ngag ze'u 'bru can/ /bdag blo nyin mor byed pas rab phye zhing / /dri med tshig gi srad bus legs sbrel ba'i/ /bstod tshig me tog phreng bas mchod par bgyi/ /gzhan phan don phyir nyid kyi sku srog la'ang / /chags pa med par 'gro la sbyin mdzad na/ /rnam smin lan la re ba smos ci 'tshal/ /de slad khyed nyid skyes bu dam pa lags/ /gang zhig yod med spros dang bral ba'i chos/ /cha shas tsam yang mi mkhyen mi mnga' na/ /gzhung lugs phyogs re'i don la smos ci 'tshal/ /de slad khyed nyid mkhas pa'i mkhas pa'ang lags/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam bzang rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pas legs rtogs na/ /srid pa'i lam las brgal ba smos ci 'tshal/ /de slad khyed nyid 'dren pa'ang dam pa lags/ /gang gis mtshan ma kun dang legs bral bar/ /chos kun mngon sum ji bzhin legs gzigs na/ /bdag lta'i mtshan ma bsnyil ba smos ci 'tshal/ /de slad khyed nyid ting 'dzin bzang po'ang lags/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /bde blag nyid du 'gro la ster mdzad na/ /yo byad cung zad sbyin par smos ci 'tshal/ /de slad 'gro ba'i mgon du bdag gis rtogs/ /phrin las bzang pos 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /brtse ba'i ma bzhin legs par skyong mdzad na/ /nyam thag skye bo skyong ba smos ci 'tshal/ /de slad phrin las bzang po bdag gis rtogs/ /gang gis tshe sngon legs par sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /gsal ba'i blo can mkhas pa'i mkhas pas kyang / /khyed kyi yon tan cha yi cha la yang / /rmad med smra ba'i seng ger bdag gis rtogs/ /gang zhig phan dgongs brtse ldan khyed nyid kyis/ /nye bar phan pa gang dang gang de dag /skal pa 'tsham par ji lta ji lta bar/ /legs par 'doms mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams kyis/

/che ba'i che bar rab grags pa/ /de dang de yis khyed kyi zhabs/ /legs bsten legs par gus pas mchod/ /blo mchog khyed kyis srid gsum na/ /na rga skye 'chi chu bo las/ /las kyis nar ba'i skye bo kun/ /kun nas sgrol ba'i gru bor 'dud/ /'khor ba'i 'jig rten rnams mi srun/ /mi srun skye bor bcas pa nyid/ /nyid kyi byang sems stobs kyis zhi/ /zhi bar mdzad pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ma chags gzhan la phan par mdzad/ /phan par mdzad pa rnams la rab/ /dam pas bsngags pa rab mdzad pa/ /rab dang mdzad par bdag rab dang / /sgrib gnyis zhi zhing ji bzhin gzigs/ /skyob mchog mgon po mchog stsol gtso/ /legs ster mkhyen brtse bde legs gter/ /phul byung dus gsum kun tu 'dud/ /khyed kyi legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /gang gi rna bar nyer lhung ba/ /de yi yid la dge ba yi/ /myu gu bskrun mdzad de la 'dud/ /sa chen 'gro ba'i rten gyur ltar/ /khyed kyi blo gros 'dab stong ldan/ /yon tan sbrang rtsi'i rten gyur cing / /sdom brtson bung ba tshim mdzad 'dud/ /thugs rje'i rtsa ba rab brtan zhing / /bslab gsum yal 'dab rab rgyas pa/ /phan bde'i 'bras bu mi zad ldan/ /dpag bsam ljon pa la phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig sbyangs pas kun mkhyen yang / /'grub na gzhan phan smos ci 'tshal/ /de phyir sbyangs pas shes bya 'ga'/ /legs par rtogs la ngo mtshar ci/ /gang zhig shes bya ma lus pa/ /mthong dang zur tsam thos pa na/ /sku tshe 'dir ni ma sbyangs par/ /khyod kyis 'bad pa med par mkhyen/ /de 'dra 'jig rten 'di na dkon/ /de bas 'jig rten srid gsum na/ /ngo mtshar bas kyang ches ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang ches rmad byung / /de ltar khyod kyi yon tan gyi/ /mtha' yi tshad gzung mi nus pas/ /srid na khyod 'dra ma mchis na/ /khyed las lhag pa smos ci 'tshal/ /de ltas nyid kyi mdzad pa rnams/ /srid mthar gyur pa'i rtsal ldan nam/

/de bas ches cher lhag pas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces nges par rtogs/ /de phyir srid pa'i sems can gyis/ /nyin bzhin khyod kyi yon tan rnams/ /bskal pa'am bskal pa lhag brjod kyang / /rdzogs par gyur na lta re skan/ /lha yi tshogs na lha dbang dang / /rgyu skar khrod na nyi zla dang / /lha mi'i khrod na rgyal ba ltar/ /lham mer bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum po yang / /khyod las gzhan du ma mchis na/ /khyod mnyes pa yis sangs rgyas kun/ /mnyes par 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal/ /de bas byang chub ma thob bar/ /spu ldang mchi ma g.yo ba yis/ /gang gā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi/ /lus sprul bas ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'jig rten kun gyi 'bru bcud dang / /sman dang lo tog skyed mos tshal/ /smon lam ting 'dzin sngags sogs kyi/ /sprul pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs dang / /'phags pa'i nor bdun gyis bkang ba'i/ /bdag blo dri med gzhal yas khang / /dus gsum dge ba'i rgyan bkra ba/ /gus pa'i blo yis blangs te 'bul/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bdag la skyabs gzhan ma mchis na/ /khyed kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /nye bar bzung nas dus kun tu/ /gnas skabs kun tu dge ba dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyi lam bzang la/ /legs par gnas shing nyer 'tshe kun/ /zhi zhing bde bas 'tsho bar mdzod/ /stong nyid snying rje'i zung 'jug pa/ /pha rol phyin drug rab rtogs nas/ /sa lam thams cad legs bgrod de/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sna tshogs pa/ /gzhung lugs kun la ma sbyangs pas/ /'dir nongs gang de bla ma dang / /mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /dge ba zla ba chu gtsang ltar/ /dkar zhing yid 'ong gang thob pa/ /de yang 'gro ba rnams la sbyin/ /de yis 'gro ba sangs rgyas shog /gang zhig gus pas bstod pa'i tshig 'di yis/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mchod byed na/ /de yi rgyud la bla ma'i byin rlabs rnams/

/myur du zhugs nas 'gro ba'i 'dren par 'gyur/ /bstod tshig 'di ni bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rab myangs pa/ /blo gros lus brtas bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes byas legs par sbyar ba yin/ /bla ma dam pa don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gcen po la bstod pa'o/ /༄༅/ /bde mchog lū hi pa rtsom bzhed pa'i mchod brjod/ na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba rā ya/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga lag len gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i dpal/ /gang gi zhabs pad dran pa tsam la yang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal rab nyer gnas pa/ /rje btsun 'gro ba kun gyi bla mar 'dud/ /thabs shes mchog gi rol pas bde chen nyer mtshon zhing / /rnam mang 'gyur ba'i zhal gyis phrin las gsal bar mdzad/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis mtha' gnyis rab tu bral bar ston/ /'od gsal nyer mtshon nyi mar bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'dud/ /de nyid sgrub byed rim gnyis kyi/ /sngon 'gro smin byed dbang gi rim/ /rdo rje 'chang mtshungs rje btsun gsung / /gsal byed grub pa'i srog bzhin dgod/ /bde mchog lū hi pa'i dkyil mchog rtsom bzhed pa'i mchod brjod yin/ /༄༅/ /cha pa chos kyi seng ge la bstod pa/ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ thub dbang nyin mor byed pa'i phrin las kyi/ /'od stong gis phye bstan pa pad mo'i phreng / /gangs ri'i khrod gnas bstan 'dzin gtsug gi rgyun/ /'byung gnas blo gros dkar ldan zhabs pad 'dud/ /de yi thugs kyi dpal las nyer bskrun zhing / /mkhas grub rnams kyi gtsug gis zhabs bsten la/ /shes bya'i cha shas tsam la'ang ma rmongs pa/ /de nyid legs gzigs mkhas pa'i mchog la 'dud/ /rgya chen gsung rab nam mkha'i lam bgrod cing / /dri med 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/

/thub bstan mkhas pa'i chu skyes kha 'byed pa/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi nyi mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /gangs ri'i khrod na zla med brjid par gnas/ /blo gros spyan yangs rtsal ldan mthu chen mnga'/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med phas kyi rgol ba 'joms/ /phun tshogs brtser ldan seng ge'i dbang por 'dud/ /gang gi mkhyen brtse'i gting mtha' rab yangs la/ /'gran par bgyi slad phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khyon/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i ngogs/ /gting mtha' yangs pa lta bur bdag gis 'khums/ /mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug thos pa'i nor gyis phyug /rtogs pa'i mdzod mnga' rje btsun rtse mo yi/ /gsung gi rjes 'brangs kun nas dang ba yi/ /bdag kyang zol med gus pas khyed zhabs mchod/ /dam pa khyed nyid gcig pu ma lags te/ /khyed gsung thos shing 'dzin pa spel ba dang / /khyed la dang bas khyed rjes slob pa yi/ /bshes gnyen de la'ang khyed bzhin gus pas bstod/ /rab dang sems kyis 'dir rtsa ba'i ma dper ldeb ma gcig ma tshang bas chad yod do/ rtsa ba'i ma dpe ma tshang / lan pa yin zer skad/ de'i don la brtags pas thugs ma bde ba sol zhing / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma skyes so/ /de'i don ni bde sdug gang byung yang / mtshan mar mi 'dzin par/ des chog par bzung nas/ sems bde ba byung na/ dkon mchog la mchod par 'bul/ sems can la sbyin par gtong / sdug bsngal byung na sems can gyi sdug bsngal dang du blang / sems bzhag sar sdod pa ni/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu bzhag nas 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad bsgrubs pas/ thams cad dge ba 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur bar bya/ blo chos dang mthun na shi yang chog ces pa'i don ni/ kun rdzob tu las rgyu 'bras spang blang thams cad phyin ci ma log par byed pa'i sgo nas/ kun rdzob dge ba dang mi 'bral bar byed/ sems skye med du rtogs na 'chi rgyu med/ ces pa'i don ni/

'chi ba la 'jigs na/ lus 'chi'am sems 'chi/ sems dang ma 'brel ba'i lus bem po la 'chi rgyu med/ sems dus gsum du brtags na/ 'das pa 'gags nas dngos por ma grub/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes nas dngos por ma grub/ da lta ba skad cig ma yin pas brtags na ma grub la/ dngos po'i chos rnams skye 'chir ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnas skabs bde sdug gang byung gis chog par byas la/ dge ba la sems rtse gcig cing / blo kun rdzob kyi chos dang mthun par/ don dam par chos thams cad skye med du rtogs par byas na gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje'i tshig bzhi la brten pa'i gdams pa/ sde sdod 'dzin pa ār+yas/ tshig nyung zhing don 'dril ba zhig zhu zer ba'i ngor/ btsun pa bsod nams kyis sbyar ba'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ rnal 'byor ma/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ bla ma puṇ+ya shrī/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o/ /༄༅/ /tshogs bdag dmar po'i mchod bstod sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /āḥgā:hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa'i/ /bla ma rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad bcas/ /tshogs kyi bdag por gus btud nas/ /bgegs 'dul 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /spyan sngar snying po phul nas ni/ /log 'dren thams cad 'dul ba dang / /'gro kun ma lus dbang bsdus nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sgrub la phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /mi nyams gtan du rgyas mdzad par/ /dam bcas gang de 'dir dgongs la/ /tshangs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /byin rlabs mchod gnas dam pa 'dir/ /bgegs sel phun tshogs rgyas pa'i phyir/ /lha chen 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /brtse bas gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /sgrub po 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba dang /

/tshe dang 'byor pa rgyas par mdzod/ /oṃ āḥgāḥsid+dhi sid+dhi/ sarba ar+tha me pra sa dha ya hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ.oṃ/ dbyibs legs kha dog sna tshogs shing / /'dab ma stong gis rab mdzes pa'i/ /pad nyi'i gdan la rab bzhugs nas/ /bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /yid 'ong gtsang zhing dag pa yi/ /mchod yon gsang gtor mchog 'di dang / /yid 'phrog me tog yid 'ong spos/ /sgron ma sna tshogs dri yi mchog /lha rdzas legs sbyar zhal zas dang / /rab mdzes gar dang snyan pa'i glu/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /bgegs 'dul lha chen bcas la 'bul/ /gzhan yang rin chen rin thang med/ /yid la 'dod dgu sna tshogs dang / /rkang 'gros sna tshogs yid 'ong rgyun/ /sna tshogs gos dang gser dngul 'bru/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis legs sprul pa/ /bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod rdzas ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te 'bul/ /sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /tshe dang bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang 'byor pa phun tshogs shing / /ci bsams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ bhū ta bi nā ya kaḥg ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ga ṇa pa ti ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ badz+ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ badz+ra dī pe pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ badz+ra nai wi d+ya pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ badz+ra shap+da pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ paṃ pad raṃ nyi'i gdan steng du/ /hūm̐ byung rdo rje las 'khrungs shing / /phyag g.yas rdo rje ba dan can/ /g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams la bstod/ /'og mas mda' gzhu rgyab nas 'gengs/ /mgo phreng rgyan drug sbrul rgyan can/ /brkyang bskum gar gyi rol mo yis/ /bgegs 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi bka' nyan mthu stobs can/ /rin chen sna tshogs brag ri'i steng / /pad nyir byi ba'i gdan la bzhugs/

/gāḥyig las byung khyod la bstod/ /bgegs kyi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag po ni/ /byi ru'i mdog can glang chen zhal/ /zhal gcig 'dzum khro mche gtsigs bstod/ /dgra 'joms rdo rje dgra sta dang / /'gro kun dbang byed rdo rje mda'/ /skye dgu 'gugs don lcags kyu dang / /bgegs 'dul rdo rje bsnams la bstod/ /gza' bsrung 'bar ba'i ral gri rno/ /bsams bzhin sgrub byed 'phang mdung rnams/ /g.yas bsnams g.yon pa'i dang po yi/ /bgegs gsod gtun shing 'dzin la bstod/ /'gro kun dbang bsdud rdo rje gzhu/ /'byung po dbang byed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'gro ba 'gugs byed thod khrag dang / /nor sgrub shas gang thod 'dzin bstod/ /gnod pa kun skyob phub dang ni/ /ba dan bcas pa g.yon pa yis/ /'dzin zhing 'bar ba'i spyan gsum bgrad/ /rab sgeg ral pa can la bstod/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis sku la brgyan/ /sna tshogs rin chen dar gyis spras/ /'od zer dmar po cher 'khrug cing / /me dpung dbus gnas khyod la bstod/ /'bras chan la phug khur ba dang / /sbrang rtsi dkar gsum rgun 'brum sogs/ /yid 'ong 'bras bu sna tshogs dang / /zhim pa'i gza' ba btung bar bcas/ /bca' ba sna tshogs gur kum sogs/ /yid 'ong dri zhim legs bgos shing / /me tog dar dpyangs la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes byas pa'i/ /zhal zas gtsang zhing yid 'ong 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /lha mi'i bdud rtsi phun tshogs par/ /byin brlabs nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs par/ /rgyun mi 'chad par blos sprul nas/ /bgegs rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdag cag bsam pa 'grub slad du/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /gzhan yang mchod pa rgya chen po/ /rin chen rgyan spras gzhal med khang / /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gzhal med khang / /bkra shis byed pa'i rdzas brgyad rnams/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing /

/ma rmos lo thog gser dngul 'bru/ /rta dang glang po shing rta'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs gos dang rin chen rgyan/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol gar dbyangs/ /go mtshon sna tshogs bran g.yog bcas/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis legs sprul ba/ /rab tu dgyes pas bzhes par mdzod/ /me tog 'bras bu shing las byung / /bcos dang sbyar ba la sogs pa'i/ /myos byed sna tshogs yid 'ong yang / /gus pas khyed la 'bul bar bgyi/ /spu sdug dbyibs legs yan lag mdzes/ /shugs chen 'gro mgyogs rngog ma brjid/ /rta mchog rin chen rgyan spras pa'ang / /bgegs 'dul khyod la 'bul bar bgyi/ /de ltar rgya chen mchod pa'i tshogs/ /lha chen 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/ /'gro ba kun gyi don slad du/ /dgyes pa chen pos rab bzhes nas/ /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyang / /rtag tu mi nyams rgyas pa dang / /'gro ba thams cad dbang bsgyur nas/ /yid la bsam pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams dang / /tshe dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /gang yang yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /lha chen mthu yis zil mnan nas/ /gus pas las rnams sgrub par mdzod/ /ci ste+e sgrub par ma gyur na/ /ci nas gnod cing 'tshe ba rnams/ /mngon spyod tshul skabs 'dir rtsa ba'i ma dper shog grangs ldeb gsum ma tshang bas chad yod do/ /nor dbang phun tshogs mang po'i gter mnga' bas/ /rnam dag zhing las lo tog ji bzhin du/ /rnam mang 'byor pas phyogs kun khyab gyur te/ /dgos 'dod mi zad gter la longs spyod pas/ /'gro ba'i smon gnas dam pa nyid 'gyur zhing / /de yi dge legs chen po'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'jig rten kun tu bde bas rab gang nas/ /kun gyis bsngags pa'i grags pa yid 'phrog dris/ /'dzin ma'i 'khor yug kun tu khyab gyur cig

/nor bdag rnams la gsol ba gdab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa btsun pa bsod nams kyis smras pa'o// //zhes pa la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pa sde tshan bdun po 'di ni/ dbus su rnam bcu dbang ldan dang / shar du 'khor lo rtsibs drug gi dbus su dhīḥrtsibs la oṃ a ra pa tsa na bkod pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes 'khor lo dang / lhor rin po che 'bar ba'i nor bu steng ma la oṃ/ 'og ma gnyis la āḥ dang hūm̐ bris pa'i rdo rje rnam pa gsum dang / nub tu pad ma 'dab ma drug gi dbus su hrīḥ'adab ma la oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bris pa dang / byang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar a/ phyogs bzhir rwa dbus ma'i sboms bzhi la mo gha sid dha bris pa rnams gter gyi bum pa las skyes pa'i pad ma dang / zla ba'i gdan la sogs ji ltar mdzes pa'i bkod pas spras pa'i 'og tu/ dge legs su bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams so sor bri zhing / gsol 'debs kyi tshig gnyis po sku so sor bris pa'i thad du bri bar bya ba 'di ni/ sne gdong rtse'i gtsug lag khang chen po so ma rnams su bkra shis dge legs 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis myur bar bskul ba'i rkyen byas te/ btsun pa bsod nams kyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/ ༄༅/ /nor bdag la gsol gdab stag brtse ba'i spyil por mdzad pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba'i phrin las dpag yas gsher ba'i khams las 'khrungs/ /phun tshogs char gyis 'gro la nor bu'i 'bras stsol ba/ /nor gyi dbang phyug dbyar skyes dbang po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dpal 'byor 'bras bzang mi zad rgyun du stsol gyur cig /yon tan rin chen rin chen bye bas dper ma mchis/ /dge legs phun tshogs phun tshogs mang po'i gzhir gyur pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang bcas/

/'gro ba'i skyabs mgon slad du zhabs brtan shog /gang la brten na phun tshogs 'gyur ba'i sku/ /'dri dang phrin tshol smon lam 'debs byed pa/ /a ba dhū tī'i bsod nams zhes bya ste/ /grogs byed yi ge bkra shis rgyal ba 'o/ /phyogs dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru'i stag brtse ba'i spyil por ming 'dogs par nor bdag la gsol gdab tu mdzad pa'o// ༄༅/ /nor lha'i gsol gdab brag kha rtser mdzad pa bzhugs// oṃ swa sti/ phun tshogs 'byor pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas/ /mi zad dpal gyis 'dod dgu kun stsol ba/ /nor sbyin rnams kyi mthu stobs dpag yas pas/ /phun tshogs mi zad rtag par 'byor bar mdzod/ /mchog gsum rin chen rnams kyi bden tshig dang / /drang srong bden smra lha mi'i dbang phyug gi/ /mthu yis shākya'i phun tshogs ma lus pa/ ji ltar 'dod bzhin dus kun 'byor gyur cig /ces pa btsun pa bsod nams kyis smras pas bkra shis par gyur cig /brag kha rtse dang / ༄༅/ /nor lha'i gsol gdab 'di'ang jo bo'i sar mdzad/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i dpal 'dzin cing / /brtse ba chen pos 'gro kun gdung ba sel/ /thub dbang rgyal tshab rgyal ba'i bstan skyong ba/ /chos rje chos kyi dbang phyug bzhin bzhin du/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal yon can/ /nor bdag me lha chu dbang 'khor gsum gyis/ /shākya'i rgyal srid dbang phyug phun tshogs nor/ /rtag tu mi nyams rgya cher 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces pa btsun pa bsod nams kyis smras pa'o/ /gnas chung na yod pa dang gnyis/ yar klung gi jo bo'i sar mdzad pa'o/ /༄༅/ nor lha'i gsol gdab/ oṃ swa sti/ phun tshogs 'dod dgu ma lus 'byor ba'i gter/ /nor gyi dbang phyug nor bdag 'khor bcas kyis/ /gnas 'dir dge legs dpal 'byor phun tshogs shing / /tshe dang bsod nams rtag tu rgyas par mdzod/

/bkra shis shing phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor pas phyogs dus kun tu rgyas par gyur cig ces pa btsun pa bsod nams kyis smras pa'o/ /'di yar klung mdo mkhar du nor lha phyag bris yod par mdzad pa'o// ༄/ /bsam yas gsos nam mdzad dus bgyis pa'i tshigs bcad sh+lau ka bzhi/ oṃ swa sti/ yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter/ /ngo mtshar bsam yas rlabs phreng can/ /bsod nams chu bo'i mdzod gyur pa/ /rmad byung gtsug lag chu gter che/ /ye shes rin chen las grub cing / /rnam 'phrul du ma'i bang rim can/ /srid par dpe zla ma mchis pa'i/ /chos sku'i rang bzhin mchod rten bzhi'i/ /char khebs gdugs dang sgo yi rgyan/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa'i phul gyi mchog /khyad 'phags bzo rigs rjes 'gro zhing / /tshogs zhib gzhan las phul phyin pa/ /bzo rigs dri med rigs byung zhing / /rgya che blo gsal bzo rigs mkhas/ /yid gzhungs chog shes bka' blo bde/ /rin chen bsam grub zhes byas bgyis/ /shubhaṃ/ bkra shis so/ /'di bsam yas gsos nam chen mo'i dus mdzad nas dbu rtse chen mo'i bar sgo'i rgyan gyi 'phul la yod pa'o// ༄༅/ /dwags por bka' gdams pa gcig la gnang ba dang / dpal ldan ye shes kyi zhus lan dang gcer mthong thug phrad gsum mo// dka' spyad rgyas kyang shin tu rnyed dka' zhing / /gang zhig thob na grol ba'i rten byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /tshe 'di don med 'da' bar mi bya 'o/ /'dus byas yin phyir nges par 'jig 'gyur la/ /blo bur rkyen gyis blo bur 'chi 'gyur zhing / /de tshe chos min gzhan gyis mi phan pas/ /skad cig gcig kyang btang snyoms mi bya 'o/ /sdig pa'i las kyi rtag tu sdug bsngal zhing / /lung du ma bstan g.yeng zhing don med la/ /zag bcas dge ba'ang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ste/ /des na rnam grol rgyu yi dge la 'bad/ /srid gsum gnas na bde ba'i skabs med na/

/nyan rang la yang don gnyis mthar mi thug /dmigs bcas dge ba'ang de dag rgyu yin pas/ /dge kun thabs shes zung gis spyad par bya/ /༄/ oṃ swa sti/ tshogs gnyis kyi mthu las dal 'byor gyi lus bskrun pa don yod pa'i mthar thug bstan pa'i snying po sgrub pa lhur len pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpal ldan ye shes kyis sgrub pa lhur len pa'i ngang nas yi ge rten phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa/ khyed rang gi mched pas 'dir thengs pas yid rab tu spro ba 'phel/ mkhan chen pa'i gsung bzhin/ der dgon par yong rtsis yin pa la/ dgon pa ba rang yang rtser pa mang gin yod par 'dug pa dang / 'dir yang sman gyis brel bas long skabs ma byung na'ang mjal ba dang khyad med pas/ sgrub pa la sngar bzhin brtson pa gal che/ slad nas mjal zhing chos kyis dus 'da' bar bgyi/ snyigs dus skye bo'i spyod yul sna tshogs pa'ang / /ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gis skyed pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba phyin ci log gi blo/ /gzhom phyir chos kun sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob blo yis rab dpyad na/ /'khrul pas 'khor ba'i mar gyur sems can la/ /brtse ba chen po lhag par skye bar 'gyur/ /de yi thabs mkhas spyod pa rgya chen 'byung / /dbang bzhi'i lam gyis zung 'jug rtogs pa bskyed/ /thun mtshams mnyam rjes bsres la yul la spyad/ /dran pa'i bskul mas rmi lam bar do sbyang / /dge ba gang bsags bla na med par bsngo/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /chos kyi snying po ston pa'i tshig /rten 'byung bcu gnyis mtshon pa yi/ /bzhi tshan gsum 'di skyes su bgyid/ /ces pa'i yi ge mi 'khyar ba'i rten mtshon par chab gser zho phyed mchis shing sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi nas chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig dge'o/ /bkra shis par gyur cig ༄/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dpal te tse ba'i dgon par 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ges/ rje btsun dam pa rgya gar la gcer mthong thug phrad kyi gdams pa gnang ba/ gang shar cer gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog la rig pas brtags pas grol du song nas rig pa rjen par 'dug pa de chos sku yin pas so/ /gyis ltos/ yin thog tu lhan gyis zhog bzhag pas sems mi rtog pa la gnas so/ /lta sgom gyi blo de zin tsa na yin thog tu lhan gyis gnas kyi shig la bor/ rtsis med du phyad kyis mthong / de nyid la rtsal rtsis med kyi shes pa sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin pas sbyongs/ gang byung bde sdug bstod smad yin min thams cad thog tu khyer la nyams len bya'o// khol/ ces gsungs mchan 'di btsun pa bsod nams kyis bris so/ /dge bas sangs rgyas myur thob shog so/ /gcer mthong thug phrad kyi gdams pa rdzogs rdzong khar bzhugs dus mkhan po shes rdor dpe la bris/ /so// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 bla ma dam pa/ kye rdo rje la bstod pa sh+loka gnyis pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
